Mobi Just Dropped a Spa on Wheels so Awesome, You’ll Want to Move In
34 photos
Photo: Mobi House
Get ready to explore one of the coolest spa concepts in the mobile habitat market – this brand-new design by one of the top tiny house builders in Europe is not only luxurious and mobile, but also modular, which means it can connect seamlessly to one or even several modular units on wheels with various configurations, to create the ultimate wellness and living space.
You’ve probably seen several Nordic saunas on wheels, one of the newest and most popular trends in the tiny living industry, and you’ve surely experienced glamping tiny home retreats with an outdoor rustic-style bathtub. The question is: have you ever seen a modular habitat on wheels that has both of these amenities enclosed under the same roof?
The brand-new Mobi Modul Spa is exactly that – an innovative and luxurious take on the classic glamping concept that brings together a fully-equipped sauna and a separate bathtub space under the same roof. This is, therefore, much more than a plain sauna on wheels, and different than the typical outdoor bathtub. Ultimately, this is a smart take on the indoor/outdoor design trend that it so popular for tiny homes right now, but with a wellness-centered twist.
Unlike many other mobile sauna designs out there, the Mobi Modul Spa is full-sized, meaning it’s just as big as the other designs in the brand’s Modular series that are intended for full-term accommodation, and that’s already a big plus. The 6.6-meter (21.5 feet) length, paired with a standard tiny house width of 2.5 meters (8 feet) and a four-meter (13 feet) height, makes room for a separate, fully-enclosed sauna, plus a separate indoor/outdoor lounge with a full-size bath.
Photo: Mobi House Exterior cladding combines wood-textured materials with corrugated metal for a modern look that also boosts resilience over time. Extensive glazing is a mandatory part of the winning formula, specifically intended to create the feeling of being outdoors, but from the comfort of a private, warm, and cozy home. Everywhere inside this tiny house, guests will be surrounded by beautiful views and will feel effortlessly connected to nature.
The layout of this unique spa concept is comprised of two separate rooms, so to speak. The indoor/outdoor lounge is the most visible part, surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass on two sides. It’s a modern-classic lounge with comfortable seating, hooks for hanging clothes, and a custom bookcase with open shelves for storage and decorative display. At the same time, it’s a glamping-style bath area with a huge, rustic-style bathtub with a wooden exterior.
This is the type of bathtub often seen in glamping tiny home resorts, outside on the deck, and sometimes inside the house. By placing it inside the Mobi Modul Spa, guests can enjoy it year-round, during any kind of weather and at any time of the day. Plus, it’s strategically placed to maximize views, for an immersive experience.
Apart from protecting it against the elements, this placement adds the indulging comfort of being at home – including the inviting warmth, practical storage, and plush seating. The storage rack – or bookcase –nearby provides easy access to snacks, drinks, everyday essentials, and personal items. In other words, the idea is to enjoy the pleasure of an outdoor hot tub inside a private space with full comfort and superb views.
Photo: Mobi House A glass door separates this multi-purpose lounge from the sauna, which is fully enclosed and equipped with everything needed for a perfect spa experience. Custom wooden benches with comfortable headrests, an electric heater, and even bespoke multicolored lighting create the most inviting spa environment, a cocoon for relaxation that feels truly luxurious.
Potted plants, decorative artwork, and mood lighting complete the fairytale ambiance of this dual-room spa concept, and, of course, every customer is free to further personalize the style of their own spa. The unit itself boasts 16.5 square meters (177.6 square feet) of floor space, and is fully equipped for connection to on-grid utilities. It sits on the THM 660 Lift &Go trailer by MH Trailers, specifically engineered to allow the trailer to be detached from the module.
The Mobi Modul Spa is awesome on its own, but even better when connected to at least one more modular unit. Mobi launched its Modular Series precisely for flexible, creative projects where two or multiple modules can be connected in various configurations (L-shaped, U-shaped, and more) to suit different scenarios and locations.
This is why the Mobi Modul Spa’s size is so important – it’s meant to connect seamlessly to another modular unit of the same size. In the photo gallery, you can see this new spa module sitting right next to tiny house Croissant, a different model in the Modular Series, boasting a residential configuration. A direct passage makes communication between these two units seamless – no uncomfortable distance between them, yet full privacy for each.
Photo: Mobi House Mobi’s concept of connected living spaces with different configurations opens up endless possibilities for both individual owner and tiny living entrepreneurs. The modular compound comprised of the Mobile Spa and tiny house Croissant can become a wonderful wellness retreat, for instance, combining a separate Spa unit with comfortable accommodation. Any individual owner can also add this structure to their property for the ultimate at-home wellness retreat.
Tiny house Croissant , the model featured in the photo gallery next to the Mobi Modul Spa, is a custom version based on the Modul Sunrise, one of the main platforms in the Mobi Modular Series. It boasts 16.2 square meters (174 square feet) of floor space, and it can accommodate up to four people. The layout features an open lounge in the center, a compact kitchen at one end, a bathroom next to it, and a tiny loft above.
This is just one example, but the Mobi Modul Spa can become part of many different configurations, alongside two or more units from the Modular Series. One of the best part is that each module comes with its own trailer, which means that the owner is able to remove or add modules over time with no hassle – mobility equals flexibility, and the modular design takes it to the next level.
Budget-wise, Mobi’s Modular Series is also one of the smartest options, because owners can start small, with a single unit, and add modules over time, when they’re comfortable with that investment.
Photo: Mobi House Imagine the positive impact this could have for beginner entrepreneurs looking to start a glamping or a small rental business, and the same goes for private owners who could start with a single unit for themselves and eventually expand their habitat for the growing needs of a family.
Better yet, this smart concept is just as much about downsizing as it is about growing over time. Full flexibility means that the owner can eventually resell one or more units from any given configuration, without impacting their main residence on wheels.
It also makes it easier to move or relocate. Plus, this kind of modular unit can stay within the family for several generations, precisely because it’s so flexible in terms of functionality and market value.
Photo: Mobi House The new Mobi Modul Spa looks great next to any other design in the Modular Series and, just as important, they look great in natural environments – contemporary, but perfectly immersed in nature. This is the kind of wellness facility that can be enjoyed anytime, any season, and in full privacy, and it doesn’t get more luxurious than that.
